events.text: Follow-up c945661df restores the original Studio interaction contract too: symmetrize no longer inherits loop cut's forced face mode; it returns to the user's vertex/edge/face tool and clears selection, preventing 28 selected vertices from being presented as the rebuilt part's 32 selected faces. Full ReleaseFast editor build passed again.

resolution: Restored the original Studio active-part boundary to host symmetrize. The host now derives an explicit target mask from the current outliner scope, repairs each targeted part around its own live-mirror bounds center, leaves every other part untouched, clears selection after topology replacement, and computes the symmetry badge with the same scoped part identities instead of one whole-soup plane. Added focused Zig regressions and verified the mesh-edit unit target plus the full ReleaseFast editor build.
